main.description: Lists actors with indexed organization sidecars. organizationTypes accepts at most 100 repeated unbracketed values and uses OR within that filter; distinct filters use AND. Omitted visibility imposes no restriction, including public, unlisted, and unspecified values; supplied visibility is an exact string match. Results sort by (createdAt, uri), default desc, with a direction-bound opaque cursor. Keep other parameters unchanged between pages. Authentication is not required.

organizationTypes.description: Exact organizationType values; OR within this filter.

visibility.description: Exact match against the sidecar visibility value. Omission adds no visibility restriction; missing values do not match a supplied value.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for (createdAt, uri); default desc.

limit.description: Maximum actors in the page; default 25.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor, bound to sortDirection.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A filter value, page bound, cursor, repeated scalar, or query parameter is invalid.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when there is no next page.
